notes.title: Lust for Darkness VR: M Edition Announced!
notes.content:
Germans and Canadians rejoice! Lusst'ghaa will open for you soon!

Ever since the premiere of Lust for Darkness VR we have noticed great interest especially from German VR players, and [b]we're very happy to announce you will soon be able to enter the Yelvertons' Victorian mansion yourselves with the M Edition![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809770/Lust_for_Darkness_VR_M_Edition/ 

In this de-sexualized and more accessible version of the game, you'll be just as terrified and just as amazed at the intense plot involving secret occult societies and immense eldritch dimensions.

The critically acclaimed PC title from 2018 has undergone a complete technical overhaul to accommodate virtual reality requirements.

[i]Lust for Darkness VR: M Edition[/i] is a psychological horror game with an intriguing plot and art design, both heavily inspired by works of Lovecraft, Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński. 

As Jonathan Moon, you receive a letter from your wife who has gone missing a year ago. Following the message, you head for a secluded Victorian mansion where a perverse occult ceremony takes place. What happens next can hardly be explained in words.

notes.title: Why your Steam review matters A LOT
notes.content:
Hey, Cultists!

We’d like to let you in on a little known secret of Steam reviews. And we’d like to ask you to leave one on the release day, March 11th. 

Regardless of the score you give to the game (it should always be honest!), user reviews inform the Steam algorithm that people are interested in this specific title. Thus, Steam recognizes its potential and gives it more exposure.

For indie developers like us, this is extremely important. 

Small studios can't compete with AAA marketing, so they have to rely on the Steam algorithm and word of mouth. 

If you wish to reward our 2.5 year development effort, we kindly ask you to review our game on Steam on the release day.

Thank you!

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.content:
Hey Cultists!

I’m Michał, the game director and producer of Lust from Beyond. We decided [b]to move the release date to March 11th[/b], and I’d like you to know why. 

The game’s complete, but our beta tests showed that we can further optimize the code and environment. We think that if we can make it better, we should. We’ll make LfB look and run smoother on older hardware. 

But even today, we’re proud of what we have! 

We’re a small studio, and we’re combining different aspects of horror. We’re making a game that’s longer than Lust for Darkness and the two LfB prologues combined. We have choices, and even elements of RPG-like character development. The prologues had a Steam rating of 88% and 82%. We aim at least this high, and with a way larger game this time.

I’ll see you in the Land of Ecstasy on March 11th. And we'll have some pleasant surprises along the way. Thanks for being with us.

Yv'h lauv'abrarc, Yv'h Lusst'ghaa!

Michał Ciastoń,
Game Director & Producer

notes.title: Important Announcement About Scarlet's Release Date
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100281/97f468f05e7ff89ae157de981c4f89a137143fcc.jpg[/img]

Dear Cultists,

Like you, we can’t wait for the premiere of Lust from Beyond: Scarlet. Just as with Lust from Beyond, we put all our hearts to this project to show you one more story before the launch of the full game.

We can confidently admit that the "Lust" series hits in slightly different subjects which can be considered by one audience as unique, or controversial by the second one. We're always caring to not cross this line too much, which requires thorough verification. It is always made not only by us, but also by Steam itself.

[b]Lust from Beyond: Scarlet is during its last verification by Steam workers.[/b] We’ve sent the game to review in time to finish any necessary procedures before October 1st. It seems that Lust from Beyond: Scarlet's final build is [b]surprisingly more strong and full of "various contents" than before for Steam.[/b] We’ve been so excited with a thought to show you something more from the "Lust" universe, but, unfortunately, Steam wants a [b]temporary exclusivity for that a bit longer.[/b]

But do not worry, we're not talking about some long terms! It is a matter of a[b] few days[/b] to finish it. [b]We'll launch "Scarlet" as fast as we get the accept.[/b] We'll inform you through [b]Steam, Facebook, and Twitter[/b] about Scarlet's availability.

Thank you for all your support and patience, and we hope that you will enjoy Lust for Beyond: Scarlet on its final release!
